description:
Find how far one recording sits from another: the sync offset of b against a, by cross-correlating their sound, with how strongly they match. Use it to line up a camera with a separate microphone, two cameras of the same moment, or a re-recorded line against the original. Each side is imported media or an edit's mix (timeline_id), over its own from_seconds to until_seconds, so you can match a short stretch of b against a longer stretch of a.
offset_seconds: b's moment t lines up with a's moment t + offset_seconds, each in its own seconds. To line them up on a timeline, place b's clip so it starts offset_seconds later than a's (earlier when negative), source starts being equal. strength is the correlation of the overlapping sound at that offset, -1 to 1: near 1 the same sound, near 0 unrelated; next_best is the best offset outside the winning peak, and a strength close to it means the match is unclear (repetitive sound, or not the same moment). Offsets are searched up to max_offset_seconds either way, where at least half of the shorter sound overlaps the other. Up to 600 s read from each side.
A side with no sound in its range (no audio stream, a range past its end, or digital silence) fails with no_audio, naming which side. Short reads answer at once; longer ones return a task or job.

a.description: The sound to line up against: the reference

timeline_id.description: An edit's mix as it plays (timeline seconds)

until_seconds.description: Read until here. Default: the end

b.description: The sound whose offset you want

timeline_id.description: An edit's mix as it plays (timeline seconds)

until_seconds.description: Read until here. Default: the end

max_offset_seconds.description: Search offsets up to this far either way

name: media.correlate

next_best.description: The best offset outside the winning peak: close to strength means an unclear match

offset_seconds.description: b's moment t lines up with a's moment t + offset_seconds, each in its own seconds; null when the sounds can't overlap by half within max_offset_seconds

overlap_seconds.description: How much sound overlaps at that offset

strength.description: Correlation of the overlapping sound at that offset, -1 to 1: near 1 the same sound, near 0 unrelated

job_id.description: Job handle; the same value is the MCP task id

media_id.description: The media it is making; usable in edits once processing

title: Sync offset
